limitations: One local Docker host with synthetic test fixtures. No cloud, external funds or production SLA claim.
Go test binaries were compiled from the recorded dirty source. PostgreSQL/Redis image IDs are dependency images; no candidate API image claim.
The lost-response test loses the caller result at the service boundary. The process-crash test terminates an actual worker child process.
Duplicate financial commands and reordered/duplicate notifications are separate scenarios. Cache loss uses a real isolated Redis flush.
All normal containers and source/index identities were checked. The calling phase separately compares normal financial fingerprints.
Raw artifacts stay in ignored local storage. The browser has no fault-execution route.
